rounds.text: Despite reported profits, Purple Wave Infocom Ltd exhibits a severe cash flow disconnect, posting a negative operating cash flow of Rs -11 Cr and a free cash flow of -25 Cr in Mar 2026, leading to a cash conversion ratio of -0.85x [E26, E28]. This cash burn is compounded by ballooning working capital requirements, with working capital days surging significantly from 53.3 days to 95.9 days [E44]. Furthermore, insider conviction is declining rapidly as promoters offloaded a massive 26.60 percentage points of their stake between Dec 2025 and Sep 2026, reducing their holding from 98.52% to 71.92% [E33]. The company also fails to reward equity holders despite its earnings, distributing a dividend yield of 0.00% [E4, E43]. Conceded: the company demonstrates strong historical profit growth and high returns on equity [E18, E21], but these paper earnings fail to translate into tangible cash generation.
